prose: The New York Times reports that insurers claim hospitals' use of AI was responsible for roughly $1B in extra expenses in 2024-25, as hospitals collect more patient data and submit larger claims. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Insurers blame hospital AI use for ~$1B in extra expenses in 2024-25
Mechanism: more patient data collected, larger claims submitted
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
